long.vo: महेंद्र सिंह धोनी. Five titles, ten finals. But some say चेन्नई just won the close ones. Is that true?
He captained two hundred and thirty-five IPL matches, and won one hundred and thirty-six. Five titles, level with रोहित शर्मा as the most by any captain. Ten finals. And two Champions League titles.

Across all one hundred and twenty-nine decided matches, चेन्नई won eighty. Sixty-two percent. The best of any franchise that played all eight seasons, ahead of मुंबई at fifty-nine.

long.title: MS Dhoni: Did CSK Just Win the Close Ones? | Myth or Data Ep 4
long.description:
MS Dhoni's Chennai Super Kings won five IPL titles and played ten finals. Did CSK just win the close ones? We checked every decided match in the eight seasons he was captain (2013, 2014, 2015, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2023, in our archive): in close finishes (10 runs or fewer, or 2 wickets or fewer) CSK won 9 of 16 (56%); in every other match 71 of 113 (63%). Overall 80 of 129 decided matches, 62%, the best of any franchise across those seasons (Mumbai Indians 59%). Verdict: busted.

Captaincy: 235 IPL matches, 136 wins, 97 losses, 2 no results (CSK and Rising Pune Supergiant); five titles, level with Rohit Sharma as the most by a captain. CSK announced his retirement from the IPL as a player on 17 November 2026.

Method: Sportmonks ball-by-ball and results, IPL 2013-2025; seasons attributed to him as captain (2016-17 CSK were suspended; 2022, 2024 and 2025 had other captains for part or all of the season, so are left out); super overs excluded.
